text:
Samir Reddy: Hey team, quick onboarding question: I enrolled in medical + dental during orientation last week but the benefits portal shows my effective date as 07/01 while I selected 06/20. I also uploaded my beneficiary form but it still displays 'not on file'. Who should I ping?

Ava (People Ops): Welcome Samir! Usually effective dates follow the company policy (first day of pay period after enrollment) but if you selected an earlier date we can check. Where did you submit the beneficiary form (BambooHR or email)?

Samir Reddy: I uploaded the beneficiary PDF to BambooHR under "Personal Docs" and clicked Submit on 06/18. Enrollment screen showed 06/20 but the portal still lists 07/01.

Sanya (Benefits): Checking enrollment queue... I see your enrollment as "Accepted" with a pending carrier sync. The carrier only accepted the file with effective start 07/01 because the enrollment hit them after the 06/16 cutoff. If you need coverage backdated to 06/20 we can request retro coverage but carriers often require proof of a qualifying event. Was there a qualifying event (e.g., loss of other coverage)?

Samir Reddy: No qualifying event. I just wanted coverage starting with my first day, which was 06/20. Is there any internal way to make the carrier pick up 06/20?

Sanya (Benefits): We can ask carrier to apply 06/20 if they allow retro adjustments, but it's not guaranteed. If you have medical expenses between 06/20-07/01 and need urgent care reimbursement, we can process a one-time manual review to help with claims.

Samir Reddy: Ok understood. Regarding beneficiary, the BambooHR upload shows "processed" but the benefits portal still says not on file.

Ava (People Ops): Benefits and payroll keep separate records for beneficiaries (benefits for life/AD&D, payroll for 401k/retirement). Which beneficiary did you upload (life insurance or 401k)?

Samir Reddy: It was the life insurance beneficiary PDF (form L-1). I haven't touched the 401k one yet.

Sanya (Benefits): I can see your life beneficiary form in our docs queue but it wasn't machine-readable (signature location odd). Can you re-upload using the template we sent in onboarding and ensure the signature page is included? If you can't, I can accept the PDF by email and manually record it.

Samir Reddy: Re-uploaded as "Reddy_Samir_life_beneficiary_06182024.pdf".

BenefitsBot: Document received. Position in queue: 2. Estimated processing within 24 hours.

Sanya (Benefits): Thanks, I'll manually verify and update the carrier record. It should reflect in the portal once processed.

Samir Reddy: Great, thanks. One more small thing 609  I filed a moving expense reimbursement in the relocation portal and it says "Approved" but I don't see the payment line on my paystub. When is that routed through payroll?

Liam (Payroll): Hey Samir, relocation reimbursements are paid as a separate taxable lump sum and go through an off-cycle run. I don't see R-4456 in today's off-cycle batch yet. Can you confirm the Relocation Approval ID?

Samir Reddy: It's R-4456, approved by People Ops on 06/19.

Liam (Payroll): Found it  it was missing the bank verification checkbox so it didn't go into the off-cycle export. I've added it and queued for the next off-cycle (ETA 07/02). You'll see a supplemental line item with description "Relocation R-4456".

Samir Reddy: Perfect, thanks Liam. Anything I should watch for on taxes for that lump sum?

Liam (Payroll): It will be taxed as supplemental wages per company policy. If you prefer withholding at a flat supplemental rate vs. aggregate, DM me and we can discuss options (may affect your net payout).

Samir Reddy: Thanks all 44d appreciate the quick responses!

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: carrier accepted effective 07/01 due to cutoff (Sanya will attempt retro request), beneficiary form re-uploaded and queued, relocation payment queued for off-cycle 07/02. Ping @people-ops if anything still outstanding.
